title: Conscious cognition is predictive work in progress, ended by automatization

statements.text: Perceptual and cognitive consciousness is a product of uncertainty, like affect itself. Declarative memory traces are revived into working memory and made labile through reconsolidation so they can be updated, and this felt reworking is the function of cognitive qualia. As soon as predictions are reliable the process becomes unconscious, so exteroceptive consciousness should wane under ambient monotony.

sources.quote: the process becomes unconscious just as soon as it possibly can
This implies that it should wane in conditions of ambient monotony
